purpose.zh: 练大腿和臀部，提升单腿控制
purpose.en: Build the thighs and glutes and single-leg control.

text.zh: 向前跨一步，身体垂直下沉
text.en: Step forward and lower straight down

text.zh: 前膝对准脚尖，前脚跟踩实
text.en: Keep your front knee over your toes and your heel down.
Push off your front foot to step back to standing.

commonErrors.en: Letting the front knee cave in.
Leaning the trunk too far forward.

cautions.zh: 膝盖不适时减小下蹲深度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Squat less deep if your knees feel uncomfortable, and stop if the pain continues.
